column1: # Existing Nerves systems for phones and tablets, indexed by what makes a device similar.
# lists the systems of that page missing here). Tab-separated, one system per line:
# flash_mode and second_stage use port.yaml's words (device.flash_mode, path.bootloader).
# layout: userdata-subimage (MBR + boot A/B + rootfs A/B + app inside userdata, mapped by an
#   initramfs) | whole-emmc (the eMMC repartitioned) | single-root (no A/B).
# template: yes when a port can start from it within the kit's invariants; no when it replaces the
#   vendor bootloader or has no A/B (read it for ideas, do not scaffold from it).

column10: U-Boot built by the system and chainloaded by the stock LK (blkmap + boot.scr); extlinux also installed, so lk2nd works too; WiFi (wcn36xx), modem over QMI, ADSP sensors

Fixed offsets, redundant fwup env, initramfs mapping with dmsetup (no kpartx); kernel from stable plus a patch series; no installer

column2: Samsung Galaxy S III Neo GT-I9301I

Same device as grouper with a newer kernel; slot switch by rewriting extlinux.conf; replaces the vendor bootloader
